reason: Every client I have came from someone recommending me, and I have never paid a leu for marketing, so paying 2,400 euro plus 140 a month for a website that the seller himself says will not bring clients makes no sense to me. The document-upload part with reminders is the only thing that spoke to me, and I cannot buy that on its own.
objection: The thing I actually want, chasing documents off my plate, is bundled with a website and an intake form I do not need, on a 12-month contract from a man who does this evenings and weekends; if his automation breaks in the week before a submission deadline, one working day of waiting is a lost project.
would_change_my_mind: Sell me the document-collection and reminder automation alone, hooked to my existing clients, for a few hundred euro setup and something like 50 a month, with a colleague in Oradea or Bucharest I can call who already uses it.
